decisions.evidence: Page rechecked against its items: the prose claims (residue identities before the central bracket, derived algebra omitting exactly d, highest-root identification of the affine node, loop/GCM isomorphism, translations, real/imaginary roots, evaluation modules, twisted loops) each correspond to a reviewed item on the page, and the item order lists suppliers before consumers. No defect.

Page rechecked: each sentence matches a reviewed example or counterexample on the page (matrix modes, Heisenberg center, all four rank-one Cartan entries, the evaluation obstruction, the central-term and normalization counterexamples); item order is supplier-before-consumer. No defect.

Page rechecked: the prose summary (formal coefficient operations, the polynomial-slice division and its Casimir exclusion, rank-one exponential weight symmetry, numerator support identification, Kostant extraction, finite and affine specializations) matches the reviewed items and their order. No defect.

Page rechecked: the described computations (finite A1 character, affine real/imaginary factors, the first two loop-degree layers of the basic module, the rank-two multiplicity comparison) are exactly the reviewed examples on the page in dependency order. No defect.

Definition rechecked: the loop bracket [x (x) f, y (x) q]=[x,y] (x) fq is well defined on the tensor product (bilinear and scalar-balancing), antisymmetric, and Jacobi holds on pure tensors and extends by trilinearity; only finite Laurent sums, no completion or AC. Consistent with the published finite-simple conventions it cites.

Rechecked the residue form omega(x (x) f, y (x) q)=B(x,y)Res(f'q dt): balanced, bilinear, omega(x_m,y_n)=m delta_{m,-n} B(x,y); existence of a nondegenerate invariant B from the Killing form is cited correctly; the normalization (theta,theta)=2 with B(e_theta,f_theta)=2/(theta,theta)=1 follows by pairing [e_theta,f_theta]=theta^vee with the Cartan. No defect.

Recomputed: Res(a' dt)=0 for every Laurent polynomial (t^-1 coefficient is 0*a_0), so omega(u,v)+omega(v,u)=B(x,y)Res((fq)'dt)=0 on pure tensors and by finite expansion in general; 2 omega(u,u)=0 and division by 2 in characteristic 0 give alternatingness. Empty and zero sums included. No defect.
Recomputed the cyclic sum: invariance gives the common scalar b=B([x,y],z), and (fq)'r+(qr)'f+(rf)'q = 2(fqr)' so the sum is 2b Res((fqr)'dt)=0; trilinear extension to finite sums. No defect.

Rechecked that the bracket on Lg (+) Cc is bilinear, alternating (alternatingness lemma) and satisfies Jacobi, with the central component exactly the cocycle identity proved; c is central, the projection is a surjective homomorphism with kernel Cc, and the vector-space inclusion of the loop algebra is correctly noted not to preserve brackets. No defect.

Rechecked D(x_m)=mx_m, D(c)=0: the loop component of the derivation identity matches, the central coefficient (m+n)m delta_{m,-n}=0 vanishes, and Jacobi for the semidirect extension is verified in all cases of numbers of d's; finite Laurent support and no AC. No defect.

Rechecked: [g,g]=g by simplicity, so every mode x_m in the derived algebra with vanishing central coefficient (m delta_{m,0}=0, including m=0); [h_1,h'_{-1}]=c with B(h,h')=1 from nondegeneracy on the nonzero Cartan; every defining bracket has zero d-coordinate, so the derived algebra is exactly Lg (+) Cc and is proper. No defect.

Rechecked the extended Cartan hhat=h(+)Cc(+)Cd, its self-centralization, the null root delta (delta|h(+)Cc=0, delta(d)=1), the level functional, and the one-directional claim that a cyclic module generated by a weight vector has level Lambda(c); the zero-module qualification is correct. No defect.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Re-derived highest-root existence/uniqueness, longness, B(e_theta,f_theta)=1, [f_theta (x) t, e_theta (x) t^-1]=c-theta^vee, all GCM entries and the minimal-realization conditions (independence of the h_i and alpha_i, dim hhat=ell+2=2(ell+1)-rank A-hat, rank-one matrix [[2,-2],[-2,2]]). No defect found.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Verified all Chevalley relations (cross relations vanish because theta+alpha_i is not a root), the Serre exponents 1-a_{i0} and 1-a_{0i} against the respective strings, absence of central terms at the modes used, injectivity via the published Cartan-meeting property, and surjectivity via the ideals J_+-, J_- and the degree induction. No defect found.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Recomputed the translation formula and its composition law, the s_0=t_{theta^vee}s_theta identity, the proof that V=span(W_0 theta^vee) is the whole coroot space, the integrality/Cauchy-Schwarz step giving M=Q^vee, and the trivial intersection with W_0 via the level functional. No defect found.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Weight spaces give the complete root list with multiplicities 1 and ell; n*delta is imaginary because delta is in the radical of the restricted form; one-sign coordinates from delta=alpha_0+theta; positive-square descent terminates at a simple root, so all alpha+n delta are real. No defect found.

Rechecked the evaluation action rho_a(x (x) f + b c)=f(a)rho(x): it is a Lie homomorphism on the loop algebra by multiplicativity of evaluation, the central term is killed, a nonzero is required for t^-1, the zero module is allowed, and no d-action is asserted. No defect.

Rechecked both directions: level zero; a compatible D must satisfy [D,rho(x)]=0 at mode 0 and [D,a rho(x)]=a rho(x) at mode 1, forcing rho=0 for a nonzero; conversely rho=0 admits every D (nonunique for V nonzero, unique for V=0). Zero module and a=1 cases included. No defect.

Rechecked diagonalizability of sigma (X^r-1 has distinct roots), the automorphism tau(x (x) t^m)=zeta^{-m}sigma(x) (x) t^m with tau(c)=c, tau(d)=d: the loop bracket is preserved by sigma-invariance of the normalized form, the central coefficient has m+n=0 hence scalar factor 1, and the fixed subalgebra is exactly the direct sum of the g_{m mod r} (x) t^m. No defect.

Recomputed for B=tr(xy) on sl_2: B(e,f)=1, B(h,h)=2 and nondegeneracy (Gram determinant -2), giving [e_m,f_n]=h_{m+n}+m delta_{m,-n}c, [h_m,h_n]=2m delta_{m,-n}c and [d,e_m]=me_m; sign, zero and opposite-mode boundaries checked. No defect.

Rechecked H=Cc (+) (+)_{m nonzero} h (x) t^m: closure and the displayed bracket, nondegeneracy of the pairing mB(h,k) between opposite modes, and the center argument (a nonzero h_j paired against k (x) t^{-j} gives jB(h_j,k)c nonzero), so the center is exactly Cc and zero Cartan modes are correctly excluded. No defect.

Recomputed alpha_0(h_0)=2, alpha_1(h_0)=-2, alpha_0(h_1)=-2, alpha_1(h_1)=2, giving [[2,-2],[-2,2]] in the row-coroot/column-root convention; rank one with null vector (1,1), alpha_0+alpha_1=delta and h_0+h_1=c. No defect.

Rechecked the explicit sl_2 matrices ([h,e]=2e, [h,f]=-2f, [e,f]=h), the mode actions a^m x with zero central action, the level-zero conclusion, and the explicit obstruction at modes 0 and 1 for a nonzero e; also a=1 and negative powers. No defect.

High risk; see the contract risk_review. Verified the exact witness [f_theta (x) t, e_theta (x) t^-1]=-theta^vee in the central-term-free bracket versus the required c-theta^vee, and the sl_2 instance -h versus c-h at modes 1,-1 with form value one. Sound refutation.

Rechecked: omega_a=a omega gives cocycle cost a instead of 1 for modes 1,-1 with B(x,y)=1; the explicit isomorphism fixing loop modes and sending c_a to a^{-1}c (forced by the bracket comparison) transports level k to a^{-1}k, with a=0 excluded and k=0 unaffected. Sound.

Rechecked the completion of coefficient arrays supported in finitely many downward cones: the convolution coefficient is finite by the coordinate bound prod_i(n_i+1), the product is supported below the sum of tops, associativity by regrouping finite sums, and inverses of 1+u by the finite geometric recursion. The limitation that no global Weyl action is asserted matches the later proofs' needs. No defect.

Rechecked existence of rho with rho(h_i)=1 by extending the independent coroots to a basis, and the nonuniqueness computation w eta = eta for every s_i hence every word, so that shifted alternants and e^rho prefactors acquire the same monomial factor and the quotient is unaffected. No AC beyond a finite basis extension. No defect.

Rechecked P=prod_{alpha>0}(1-e^{-alpha})^{m_alpha} and D=e^rho P: coefficients are finite integer sums by the coordinate bound, the support lies in -Q^+, the constant coefficient is one, invertibility holds by the finite recursion, and the simple-axis coefficient is 1-e^{-alpha_i}. No analytic product limit is asserted. No defect.

High risk; see the contract risk_review. Verified the factor transform (1-e^{-alpha_i}) -> -e^{alpha_i}(1-e^{-alpha_i}), the reindexing over positive roots other than alpha_i, and the determinant sign. No defect.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Verified the p(X) induction, the two exact sequences, the top-down uniqueness, the Casimir constraint (mu+rho)^2=(Lambda+rho)^2 from centrality, the integral unitriangular inversion and c_Lambda=1. No defect found.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Re-derived the transverse-slice division, including the anti-invariant/invariant product relation that makes R_b a polynomial with R_b(1)=0 and q invariant; verified the W-invariance of C, its cone support and the least-height nonpositive pairing step. No defect found.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Verified the trivial-module expansion giving D=sum c_mu e^{mu+rho} with beta^2=2(rho,beta), the least-height inequalities beta^2<=0<2(rho,beta), and the nonvanishing step p_beta=C_beta (a_beta=0 because beta=rho-wrho would satisfy the same equality). No defect found.
High risk; see the contract risk_review. The identity is the assembly D=e^rho P=a e^rho from C=1, with both sides coefficientwise locally finite. No defect.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Verified the exponential conjugation identities, THT^-1=-H, the h^perp decomposition giving ThT^-1=s_i h, the isomorphism V_mu -> V_{s_i mu}, and the array-level product transform. No defect found.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Verified impossibility of a zero label, the terminating reflection descent to strictly positive labels, the strict positivity of lambda^2-eta'^2 unless gamma=0, the telescoping height bound with trivial stabilizer, and the coefficient det(w). No defect found.

High risk; see the contract risk_review. Numerator and denominator identities assemble into both displayed forms; P^{-1} exists with finite coefficients and Lambda=0 recovers the denominator identity. No defect.

Rechecked the definition P^{-1}=sum K(beta)e^{-beta} with K=0 off Q^+: the multinomial expansion of (1-x)^{-m}, the separating-slot count, the finite coordinate bound, K(0)=1 and the empty-root-system case; no analytic convergence or AC. No defect.

High risk; see the contract risk_review. Verified beta=delta_w+gamma gives l(w)<=ht(beta) and finiteness, and that coefficient extraction reproduces K(w(Lambda+rho)-(mu+rho)); mu=Lambda gives K(0)=1. No defect.

High risk; see the contract risk_review. Verified that the cited finite-type supplier establishes finite dimension, semisimplicity, Cartan spanned by coroots and all roots real, so multiplicities are one and W is finite and faithful; the quotient is the formal inverse. No defect.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Verified the disjoint exhaustive families of positive real roots and the imaginary family with multiplicity ell, reproducing the displayed product; rank-one multiplicity one checked. No defect.

Rechecked the remark: coefficient bounds justify the sums, products, inverses and extractions; no analytic convergence, no rearrangement, no evaluation at a zero denominator, and Weyl symmetry only for the arrays actually used. Consistent with the proofs. No defect.

High risk; see the contract risk_review. Recomputed the rank-one quotient and the polynomial division with x=e^{-2omega}, giving sum_{j=0}^m e^{(m-2j)omega} and dimension m+1; m=0,1 checked. No defect.

Rechecked the specialization ell=1, Phi_0^+={alpha}: real factors (1-z q^n) for n>=0 and (1-z^{-1}q^n) for n>=1 with the imaginary product over (1-q^n), and the degree-one expansion P=(1-z)(1-(1+z+z^{-1})q+O(q^2)) including both index endpoints. No defect.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Recomputed the translated weights, the truncation of U below degree three, the q^2 cancellation in P/(1-z) between the n=1 and n=2 triples, and S^2-T=2+z+z^{-1}. No defect found.

Rechecked the affine A_2 witness: the delta factor is (1-e^{-delta})^2=1-2e^{-delta}+e^{-2delta} while the proposed replacement is 1-e^{-delta}; no other positive root below delta is imaginary, and terms of higher degree cannot contribute, so the coefficients at e^{-delta} differ by exactly one. Sound.

Page rechecked against its items: the prose claims (block induction from a unique bimodule summand, central characters and the centralizer criterion, normal-p-subgroup Brauer projection, idempotent lifting, the choice-free bijection, the declared AC for the Green identification, block compatibility by explicit splitting maps, the full-defect module corollary) each correspond to a reviewed item, in supplier-before-consumer order. No defect.

Page rechecked: the summary matches its four reviewed items (the S_7 defect-D_8 correspondence, the SL_2(F_p) positive-defect blocks and Steinberg block, the non-necessity counterexample, and the trivial-defect/identity-normalizer boundary), page order respecting dependencies. No defect.

High risk; see the contract risk_review. Verified the bijection between unital k-algebra maps Z(kG)->k and primitive central block idempotents, using a simple quotient of a nonzero block and the published local-centre claim that the block bimodule endomorphism algebra (equivalently Z(B)) is local with nilpotent maximal ideal; the characterisation lambda_b(b)=1, lambda_b(c)=0 is correct. No defect.

Rechecked the definition b^G=B by the unique block with b | Res_{HxH}B, the split-inclusion meaning of |, the non-isomorphism of distinct block bimodules (left multiplication by the block idempotent separates them), the Krull-Schmidt multiplicity remark, and the explicit statement that the value is undefined if no block or more than one block has the property, with H=G giving b^G=b. No defect.

Rechecked the vertex argument: relative Delta E-projectivity of B, Mackey restriction to HxH, summand extraction for b, vertex containment Delta D conjugated into Delta E, then projection to the first coordinate giving D<=gEg^{-1}; the lemma asserts containment only, with D=1 and H=G boundaries. Matches Farrell-Lassueur Prop 40.3(a). No defect.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. I verified the load-bearing claim that the (HxH)-bimodule endomorphism ring of b is Z(b) (independently checked by machine computation in F_2S_3: dim End_{S_3xS_3}(B_1)=1=dim Z(B_1), so the claim is not refuted by non-local block algebras), the corner multiplicativity modulo the nilpotent maximal ideal, the block-projection evaluation lambda_B(z)=lambda_b(pi_H(z)), the definedness argument via point-stabilizer vertex exclusion and multiplicity one, and the orbit argument converting pi_H into Br_D under the normalizer hypothesis. Statement matches Martinez Theorem 4.5. No defect found.

Rechecked the composed split maps c -> Res b -> Res Res B, their composite identity, and the uniqueness step identifying (c^H)^G with c^G; the proof correctly assumes and does not deduce definedness. No defect.

High risk; see the contract risk_review. Verified the D-orbit localization argument (p-power orbit lengths, constant coefficients, identical operators on simple modules, orbit sum zero in characteristic p) giving lambda_b(z)=lambda_b(Br_D(z)), and the primitive-idempotent indicator comparison. No defect.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Verified the maximal-pair construction of e=Br_D(f) as one N-orbit sum, its centrality and primitivity (stable subsets of a transitive orbit), Br_D(e)=e, defect group D for kNe by maximal Brauer support, and identification b^G=B through lambda_{b^G}(f)=lambda_b(Br_D(f))=1. No defect found.

Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Verified the Sylow-in-centralizer argument forcing all support elements of e to be D-Sylow-centralized, the central class sum a with Br_D(a)=e, the lifting of e through the finite commutative quotient, the uniqueness of the block image equal to e, and the exclusion of any larger S>D by Br_R(e)=Br_R(f). Critical item; see the contract risk_review. Both induced central characters take value one at the global idempotent f, so lambda_b(e)=lambda_c(e)=1 for a primitive e and both blocks equal kNe; empty and singleton cases are explicitly allowed. No defect.

High risk; see the contract risk_review. The three lemmas assemble into a bijection from local defect-D blocks to global defect-D blocks; conjugation equivariance is transported through the algebra isomorphism x -> gxg^{-1} acting on the double-group bimodule, and empty sets and N=G are covered. Matches the cited sources (Martinez Thm 4.10, Craven Thm 1.12, Farrell-Lassueur Thm 40.4). No defect.

Rechecked the definition of the Brauer correspondent as the unique defect-D block of N_G(D) inducing to B, its existence and uniqueness from the proved bijection, the transport under D -> gDg^{-1}, and the N_G(D)=G (including D=1) case where it is B itself. No defect.

High risk; see the contract risk_review. Verified the explicit induction/tensor isomorphism, its balancing and H-linearity computations and inverse maps, and the vertex-containment consequence for summands, including Q=1 forcing X=0. No defect.
